alkylation reagent: alkylate with 50 mM chloroacetamide (Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, MO, USA) for 20 min at 37 °C
alkylation concentration: alkylate with 50 mM chloroacetamide (Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, MO, USA) for 20 min at 37 °C
cleavage agent: A 1:50 (w/w) trypsin:protein ratio dissolved in 50 µL digestion buffer was added to the spin filter
collision energy: at a normalized collision energy of 27.
fragmentation method: selecting up to 12 precursor ions with a mass window of m/z 1.6 based on highest intensity for HCD fragmenting
instrument: to a Q Exactive Plus mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific, Waltham, USA).
ionization type: The system was coupled online with an emitter for nanospray ionization (New objective picotip 360-20-10)
labeling: A label-free quantative analysis was performed in MaxQuant 1.5.1.2.
reduction reagent: Protein disulfide bonds were reduced with 12 mM tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine (Thermo Scientific, Waltham, MA, USA) for 30 min at 37 °C
reduction concentration: Protein disulfide bonds were reduced with 12 mM tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine (Thermo Scientific, Waltham, MA, USA) for 30 min at 37 °C
